constraints.ocl:

context Post

context Group

context Conversation

context User
inv: (self.posts->one(x | x.isPublic = true)) and (self.email.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')

context Conversation
inv: (self.participants->one(x | x.createdAt <> '')) and (self.createdAt <> null)

context Follow
inv: (self.follower.profile.birthDate <> '') and (self.followedAt.indexOf('test') >= 0)

context FriendRequest
inv: (self.fromUser.profile.fullName <> '') and (self.createdAt.size() >= 2 implies self.createdAt.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context Notification
inv: (self.recipient.profile.birthDate <> '') and (self.message.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')

context Membership
inv: (self.user.profile.birthDate <> '') and (self.role.size() = 19)

context Profile
inv: (self.user.profile.bio <> '') and (self.bio.size() = 26)

context Comment
inv: (self.post.author = self.author) and (self.createdAt.size() >= 16)

context User
inv: (self.profile <> null) and (self.username.size() >= 2 implies self.username.substring(1, 2) = 'AB')

context Reaction
inv: ((self.post.isPublic) and (self.type <> null)) and (self.createdAt <> '' and self.createdAt.size() > 0)

context Reaction
inv: ((self.post.author = self.user) and (self.post.oclIsTypeOf(Post))) and (self.user.oclIsTypeOf(User))

context Comment
inv: (self.post.author.email <> '') and (self.createdAt <> '' and self.createdAt.size() > 0)

context Group

context Post
